latestVersion.changelog:
AI with AI 1.0.0 — Initial Release

- Launches an AI-powered video editing skill for collaborative, automated video processing (MP4, MOV, AVI, WebM up to 500MB).
- Simple onboarding: generates free 7-day tokens (100 credits) for new users and connects automatically.
- Drag-and-drop uploads, natural language editing commands, and fast cloud GPU rendering (1–2 minutes per job, max 1080p MP4 output).
- Transparent session/token management, easy re-authentication, and detailed error handling.
- Supports batch, iterative, and quick-edit workflows for content creators.
- All actions (export, credit check, upload, status, editing) routed via clear keyword-based intent detection.
